questions.q: Why does this report add a CategoryName slicer, even though it only has four categories?
options: It lets the Merchandising Manager isolate or compare specific categories live during the pricing review, without losing the full picture
Slicers are necessary for DAX measures to calculate correctly at all
Power BI requires at least one slicer on every published report
It replaces the need for the bar chart
questions.explain: The underlying data already covers every category; the slicer adds the ability to narrow the view during the live conversation, which the report didn't have before.

questions.q: Why does the slicer allow multi-select rather than single selection only?
options: Single-select slicers cannot be built on CategoryName
The manager may reasonably want to compare two categories side by side during the discussion, not just isolate one
Multi-select improves the report's refresh performance
Multi-select is required by Power BI for any slicer built on a text column
questions.explain: A pricing conversation might reasonably compare, say, Bikes against Components, which single-selection would not support.

questions.q: Why are number formats set on the measure itself rather than on each individual visual?
options: Measure-level formatting only works for currency values
It is required before a slicer can be added to the page
Power BI does not allow formatting to be set on individual visuals
Formatting the measure once means every card, chart, and table using it inherits the same format automatically
questions.explain: Setting the format once on the measure avoids having to repeat the same formatting choice separately on the card, the chart, and the table.

questions.q: What number format does this lesson recommend for Average Order Value, and why?
options: Currency with no decimal places, matching Total Sales
Percentage format, since it is a ratio of two other measures
Currency with two decimal places, because a per-order average is small enough that cents can matter for comparison
Whole number with no currency symbol, matching Order Count
questions.explain: Unlike the large totals, a per-order average is a small enough number that decimal precision is useful, so it keeps two decimal places.

questions.q: What is wrong with a default visual title like "Sum of TotalSalesAmount by CategoryName"?
options: Power BI does not allow default titles to be published
It states what field is on the chart, not what the number means to the reader
It causes the DIVIDE function to return blank
It is too long to fit on a Power BI canvas
questions.explain: A title that only repeats field names tells the reader what's being shown, not what it means -- the opposite of what a time-pressed reader needs first.
